brief: Prioritise Ashford Bluff 138/13kV for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because it is a unit of advanced age with a history of high loading, giving it a reduced margin against mechanical failure as detailed in MG-023. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed by MG-023.
